acquisition_method: the TripleTOF 6600 was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode for MS and MS/MS data collection.
alkylation_concentration: reduced and alkylated with 10 mM TCEP and 40 mM iodoacetamide
alkylation_reagent: reduced and alkylated with 10 mM TCEP and 40 mM iodoacetamide
cleavage_agent: CaCl2 (final concentration 2 mM) and trypsin (ThermoFisher Scientific; 1:50 trypsin:protein ratio, with a total protein concentration of 3 mg ml−1) were then added, and the samples were digested on the filter for 18 h at room temperature.
enrichment_method: volumes of peptide samples corresponding to equivalent volumes of starting plasma were loaded onto a SNA-I lectin agarose column (0.25 ml bed volume, Vector Laboratories) in 25 mM Tris buffer (pH 7.4) with 50 mM NaCl, 10 mM CaCl2 and 10 mM MgCl2, and the bound material was eluted
fragmentation_method: followed by collision-induced dissociation of precursor ions to produce MS/MS spectra from the 15 most abundant precursor ions.
instrument: LC–MS/MS analysis was performed using a NanoLC 425 Ultra system (Eksigent Technologies) interfaced with a TripleTOF 6600 mass spectrometer (SCIEX).
ionization_type: Using electrospray ionization, the TripleTOF 6600 was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode for MS and MS/MS data collection.
labeling: inferred: No isobaric labels were used in this study.
ptm: A given peptide was scored as present if it reached >95% confidence according to the algorithm and contained at least one N-X-S/T/C motif (where X is any amino acid except for glycine or proline) whose asparagine (N) showed the deamidated ‘scar’ (that is, aspartic acid substitution) that resulted from PNGase F treatment.
reduction_concentration: reduced and alkylated with 10 mM TCEP and 40 mM iodoacetamide
reduction_reagent: reduced and alkylated with 10 mM TCEP and 40 mM iodoacetamide
